tasks.name: feature_order_inventory_reservation
tasks.task: Implement place-order and cancel-order. place-order must quote, create an order, reserve inventory, and persist orders.json and inventory.json. cancel-order must cancel an unpaid reserved order and release inventory. Do not only print success.
verify_setup_commands: import json; from pathlib import Path; data=Path('data'); orders=[{'id':'O1001','customer_id':'C001','sku':'SKU-RED','quantity':1,'status':'paid','subtotal':'100.00','discount_total':'10.00','tax_total':'7.43','total':'97.43','created_at':'2026-07-03T09:00:00+00:00','applied_coupons':['SAVE10'],'events':[]},{'id':'O1002','customer_id':'C002','sku':'SKU-BLUE','quantity':2,'status':'paid','subtotal':'60.00','discount_total':'12.00','tax_total':'3.96','total':'51.96','created_at':'2026-07-03T10:00:00+00:00','applied_coupons':['VIP20'],'events':[]}]; inventory={'SKU-RED':{'available':10,'reserved':1,'damaged':0,'reorder_point':3},'SKU-BLUE':{'available':20,'reserved':0,'damaged':1,'reorder_point':5},'SKU-GROCERY':{'available':8,'reserved':0,'damaged':0,'reorder_point':4},'SKU-DIGI':{'available':999,'reserved':0,'damaged':0,'reorder_point':0}}; (data/'orders.json').write_text(json.dumps(orders, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8'); (data/'inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
